messages:
alex: seeing a sudden spike of 502/504s hitting hosted inference in eu-west starting ~00:07 UTC. p95 latency for text-generation routes jumped from ~120ms to 2.3s and a bunch of customer 5xx reports. anyone else?

sre_jen: I'm on it. initial check: gateway logs show increased upstream timeouts to the runtime pool; connection reset + downstream 504s. no obvious OOM on GPUs yet.

maria_support: flagged 3 paying customers reporting request failures and timeouts. collecting request IDs now. one ticket includes this curl response: 
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" 
  -d '{"input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
* HTTP/2 504
* recv() failed (104: Connection reset by peer)
```

sam_engineer: I pushed a tiny routing tweak two hours ago to prefer nodepool-b for burst traffic in eu-west. rolling that back now to see if it helps.

ops-bot: autoscaler: nodepool-b CPU 85% -> scaled +2 nodes at 00:12 UTC; nodepool-a unchanged.

sre_jen: note: we also see a spike of auth-service 429s around the same time. Not sure if auth retries are amplifying load. Maria, can you share any failed auth error IDs?

maria_support: sending a few request_ids in the DM to the team. one shows `auth_proxy: downstream 502` in the trace.

sam_engineer: rollback completed at 00:20 UTC. routing reverted to nodepool-a as primary.

deploy-bot: canary rollback to routing v2026.11 -> started at 00:20 UTC -> success.

sre_jen: after rollback, 502 rate dropped ~70% within 3 minutes. still seeing some 504s on long requests (>3s). likely multiple contributors: auth throttles + new routing path.

alex: good quick mitigation. what's the next mitigation for the remaining 504 tail?

sre_jen: temporary mitigations: 1) increase gateway upstream timeout from 2s -> 5s for text-generation endpoints 2) enable fallbacks to smaller model variant for requests > 2s 3) block preforking large batch requests from the customer-facing route. I'll apply 1 & 3 now.

sam_engineer: applying timeout change and enabling smaller-model fallback flag in config: 
```yaml
routes:
  /v1/generate:
    upstream_timeout: 5s
    fallback_model: gpt-small-2025
```

ops-bot: config push started at 00:32 UTC, rolling restart of 6 gateway pods.

maria_support: customer comms: I've posted interim status to affected accounts and offered mitigations (retry logic + smaller model option) while we investigate root cause.

pm_nina: please capture action items and owners — we'll need a postmortem and customer follow-up doc.

alex: quick summary for the war room: 1) spike started 00:07 UTC 2) root suspects: routing change -> nodepool-b + auth 429s amplifying retries 3) rollback at 00:20 reduced 5xx by ~70% 4) timeout bump + fallback enabled at 00:32 reduced tail 504s to near normal by 00:40.

sre_jen: logging notes for postmortem: collect gateway->runtime latency histograms, auth service 5xx/429 timelines, nodepool-b kube events, and autoscaler scale events. also gather request traces for the customer request_ids Maria shared.

sam_engineer: quick repro attempt steps I ran: 
1) send burst of 200 concurrent light requests to /v1/generate with auth token X
2) observe 502/504 tide on nodepool-b only
3) routing rollback removed the pattern.

maria_support: action items for support: follow up with the 3 customers and confirm if fallback to smaller model meets SLA; offer incident summary and ETA for postmortem.

pm_nina: action items (assigning owners):
- Alex: draft incident timeline & publish to #all-hands (ETA EOD)
- SRE_Jen: gather logs/traces, produce RCA draft (ETA 24h)
- Sam: full audit of routing change + test matrix for nodepool-b (ETA 48h)
- Maria: customer comms + ticket updates (ongoing)
- Infra: review autoscaler thresholds (assigning to ops team)

sre_jen: one more: add a regression test that simulates auth 429 spikes to verify we don't amplify retries.

alex: closing war room for now — monitoring phase. will reopen if 5xx > baseline for 15m. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
